queries.query: SELECT o_ol_cnt, count(*) AS order_count FROM ch.orders WHERE o_entry_d >= $1 AND o_entry_d < $2 AND EXISTS (   SELECT $3 FROM ch.order_line WHERE o_id = ol_o_id AND o_w_id = ol_w_id AND o_d_id = ol_d_id   AND ol_delivery_d >= o_entry_d) GROUP BY o_ol_cnt ORDER BY o_ol_cnt
SELECT count(*) FROM ch.orders o WHERE o_ol_cnt <> (SELECT count(*) FROM ch.order_line WHERE ol_w_id = o_w_id AND ol_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_o_id = o_id)
SELECT ol_i_id, ol_supply_w_id, ol_quantity, ol_amount, ol_delivery_d FROM ch.order_line WHERE ol_w_id = $1 AND ol_d_id = $2 AND ol_o_id = $3
WITH delivered AS (UPDATE ch.order_line SET ol_delivery_d = now()   WHERE ol_w_id = $1 AND ol_d_id = $2 AND ol_o_id = $3 RETURNING ol_amount) SELECT coalesce(sum(ol_amount), $4) FROM delivered

SELECT ol_o_id, ol_w_id, ol_d_id, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue, o_entry_d FROM ch.customer, ch.new_order, ch.orders, ch.order_line WHERE c_state LIKE $1 AND c_id = o_c_id AND c_w_id = o_w_id AND c_d_id = o_d_id AND no_w_id = o_w_id AND no_d_id = o_d_id AND no_o_id = o_id AND ol_w_id = o_w_id AND ol_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_o_id = o_id AND o_entry_d > $2 GROUP BY ol_o_id, ol_w_id, ol_d_id, o_entry_d ORDER BY revenue DESC, o_entry_d LIMIT $3
SELECT count(DISTINCT s_i_id) FROM ch.order_line, ch.stock WHERE ol_w_id = $1 AND ol_d_id = $2 AND ol_o_id < $3 AND ol_o_id >= $4 AND s_w_id = $5 AND s_i_id = ol_i_id AND s_quantity < $6
INSERT INTO ch.order_line (ol_w_id, ol_d_id, ol_o_id, ol_number, ol_i_id, ol_supply_w_id, ol_quantity, ol_amount, ol_dist_info) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
INSERT INTO ch.order_line (ol_w_id, ol_d_id, ol_o_id, ol_number, ol_i_id, ol_supply_w_id, ol_quantity, ol_amount, ol_dist_info) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)

SELECT $3 * sum(CASE WHEN i_data LIKE $4 THEN ol_amount ELSE $5 END) / ($6 + sum(ol_amount)) AS promo_revenue FROM ch.order_line, ch.item WHERE ol_i_id = i_id AND ol_delivery_d >= $1 AND ol_delivery_d < $2

SELECT ol_number, sum(ol_quantity) AS sum_qty, sum(ol_amount) AS sum_amount, avg(ol_quantity) AS avg_qty, avg(ol_amount) AS avg_amount, count(*) AS count_order FROM ch.order_line WHERE ol_delivery_d > $1 GROUP BY ol_number ORDER BY ol_number
SELECT ol_w_id, ol_d_id, count(*) AS lines, sum(ol_quantity) AS quantity, sum(ol_amount) AS amount FROM ch.order_line WHERE ol_i_id = $1 GROUP BY ol_w_id, ol_d_id ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT ol_w_id, ol_d_id, count(*) AS lines, sum(ol_quantity) AS quantity, sum(ol_amount) AS amount FROM ch.order_line WHERE ol_i_id = $1 GROUP BY ol_w_id, ol_d_id ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT sum(ol_amount) AS revenue FROM ch.order_line WHERE ol_delivery_d >= $1 AND ol_delivery_d < $2 AND ol_quantity BETWEEN $3 AND $4
select count(*), min(ol_w_id), max(ol_w_id) from ch.order_line
select count(*) from ch.order_line where ol_w_id >= $1
